title: scene-server: normalize SceneRegion spawnOrientation (L144)
description: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 L144: 'If the server does not reject the value, it MUST normalize the quaternion to unit length before storage.' SceneRegion/set accepts spawnOrientation within 1e-6 (crate-jmap-scene-server/src/region.rs via helpers::unit_quaternion) but stores it unnormalized. SceneObject (JMAP-38uq.4) uses a 1e-3 tolerance, because the draft's own object examples are three-decimal (L1461, L1488), and normalizes, echoing on update. Decide whether to align the region epsilon with 1e-3 and normalize spawnOrientation the same way. Found while implementing JMAP-38uq.4.
notes:
